alt: Sketch of a dart-shaped four-sided shape with a dent, where flipping its inner edge makes the two new triangles overlap; the original grader accepts the flip and scores it (41 on the four-point test input) and the fixed version rejects it as an invalid flip. On real hidden case 0009 one forbidden flip lowers (improves) the score from 644,809 to 641,611.
caption: The original grader accepts flips the rules forbid, and one even improves the score (lower is better: 644,809 to 641,611 on hidden case 0009); the fixed version rejects them.
